S.FORM: == kakiliman == lunuk paculil a kazizeng 自動駕駛汽車 lunuk paculil a kazizeng "kamu nu Ing, Autonomous vehicles,Self-driving automobile", panganga aca tu naya ku tademay paculil a kazizeng, u tinnaw ku paculilay a kazizeng, nayay ku tademaw a kazizeng, kikayay a kazizang, anca lunuk paculil a kazizeng, zuma u tademaw ku paculilay anca caay pikuwn tu kazizeng. mala u sapisuped tu paya, lunuk paculil a kazizdng kapah cay ku tademaw ku paculilay taneng a mikinsa tu hekal atu mituzu' tu pazayzaan saculilan. 自動駕駛汽車(英語:Autonomous vehicles,Self-driving automobile), . nilaculan katukuh 2023 amihcaan, caay kahamin u lunuk paculil a kazizdng hamin u mahizaay tu u sapacakay, hatu u mahizaay tu nu kazizeng a hekal, u nipahecek a kazizeng, anca u sapaazih a kazizeng, zuma u nalimaan ku azihen kya misataneng misanga' tu mahizaay a kazizeng, haymaw hizahiza satu. lunuk paculil a kazizeng taneng tu lye-ta, kowng-sye lye-ta, sapikinsa,GPS atu piazih tu tennaw a nalimaan mikinsa tu hekal. macakatay a pikuwan taneng mikinsa tu nisulita masumad matatungus ku saculi a zazan, atu satena' a bacu. Pakay mahini a nipaeneng atu nisanga'an tu ti-tu "SLAM" a nalimaan, pabaluhay tu zuma a sakatineng a ti-tu, ngay tulin sa mikilul ku kazizeng tu kitizaan. maawas ku yadahay nu lunuk paculil a kazizeng masa nayay paculilay tu kazizeng a sakaput taneng amiwada' tu ngelu', sakasa apacakat tu saculilan a kalamkam a miculu' a patayza. lunuk paculil a kazizeng u pikinsa talaayaw tu 1920 a ziday kya a taneng mikinsa, malaheci ku zuma. saayaway a tatenga'ay nu lunuk paculil a kazizeng katukuh 1980 a mihcaan kya saayaway a tahkal. 1984 a mihcaan, K-ney-ci-melung aa atalakaway a cacudadan micuzuh tu Navlab atu ALV a nisabalucu'an, 1987 a mihcaan, Me-say-te-s-Pin-s atu Mu-ni-hey lyen-pang kukub hitay a talakaway a cacudadan mapulung micuzuh tu nisabalucu'an ni Yu-li-ka-pu-low-au-siw-s. Yadah ku ay a tabakiay a kusi atu migingkuway a sakaput malingatu tu misanga' tu mahizaay tu nu lunuk paculil a kazizeng, pasu Me-say-te-sa pins, tung-yung kazizeng, Talu kazizeng, lAV, meyan, Law-puw.poe-s kusi, Zipun a nisanga'an a kazizeng,ley-now, Toyuta kazizeng, Aw-ti, bu-haw sakaput, paw-s kazizeng, pa-al-ma talakaway a cacudadanay a Vislab, niw-cin talakaway a cacudadan, atu Google. zikuz nu 21 seci, m ikilul tu sapasingding a macakat, bahal satu macakat, hamin u lunuk paculil a kazizeng mitanamay tu kazizengay u masan ga'ay tu, te-s-la a kazizeng u saayaway a nipanutekan a patahkal tu lunuk paculil a kazizeng. 2013 a mihca 7 a bulad, 2013 a mihca 7 a bulad, Vislab paazih tu BRAiVE hananay nu lunuk paculil a kazizeng, mitanam mikinsa tu ngatu zazan pasu "zuma malecaday tu a kazizeng" muculil i zazan. katukuh 2013 a mihcaan, Ameylika sepat a kuwanan "Ney-huwa-ta-cow, How-cow, Cya-cow atu Mi-siken-cow" maawas tu nu hulic misulul tu lunuk paculil a kazizeng. 2015 a mihcaan. uyni sepatay a kuwan atu How-sen-tun-Ke-lun-piya-te a kitizaan misulul tu tu lunuk paculil a kazizeng paculil i zazan a mikinsa, mikilul tu ku Wiy-ci-ni-ya-cow. 018 a mihca 3 a bulad 18 a demiad a tu labii,I Ya-li-san-na-cow-tan-pey-s, cacay lunuk paculil a kazizengay a Uber a kazizeng habelutan ku cacay nu micaliwayay i zazan a tademaw mapatay. uyni u saayaway nu kitakit a lunuk paculil a kazizang nu simapatayay nu tademaw. tizaay a tayzin mihapiw tu mihcaan nu mapatayay 49 ku mihcaan ci He-cepoke "Elaine Herzberg", kazizeng izaw ku palihalayay apaculilay, itaway muenengay i paculilan, caay kaitiza maduka. Namahini ku kawaw, mahabelutay a tademaw makay ayaw nu kazizang kawilian micuzuh tu batikal, caay henay pihaymaw paculnil atu piliyas ku nipaculil, hakay u patelac nu lunuk paculil a kazizeng. patahkal ku tayzin tu niadinguan paazih, situngusa a tademaw caay piazih, itawya i labu nu kaziza pacemek niza miazih tu limaki, caay pihapinang amiazih. misetulay a kazizeng sa bu-haw XC90 SUV. Ameylika kanatak saculil a zazan nu mikuwanay "National Highway Traffic Safety Administration" i pasay zazan tu pakay saykay a nipatahkalan a kamu hinisa, uyni a sakaput "tu pakayniay a akawaw" atu yu-pu, bu-haw, lyen-pang-tang-ci,cow atu tizaay a kuwan makakaput tu" amisatudung a mikawaw. XC90 SUV. . saculilan tungus tekeday pulung nu kayadah Zipun Toyota u silac nu ngangan u icibangay, Ameylika bu-te atu tung-yumg a kazizang pazuma tu ngangan u sakatusa atu sakatulu. Pi-li-s, Ba-kow, I-tali atu Ing-kow misabalucu' amin au lunuk paculil a kazizeng ku mikawaway tu miculu' patayza, i Te-kow, He-lan atu S-pan-ya a kanatalan, misulul tu amin tu mitanam tu kakapah nu lunuk paculil a kazizeng. 2015 a mihcaan, Ing-kow a cebu misulul tu lunuk paculil a kazizeng LUTZ Pathfinder i Mi-al-tu -kay-en-s a zazan mikinsa. yu malaheci tu keci tu lunuk paculil a kazizenge, alesan tu ku silamalay a zazan caay katahpu ku saculilan. hamin u lunuk paculil a kazizang anu tanenng pasazumaen tu nu siwbayay, amahamin mapeci pabaluhay a tabaki ku nkalilid nu syakay. lunuk paculil a kazizeng hakay katuud ku micukaymasay imahini nayi' henay ku wanta, anu tatenga' katuud ku micukaymasay, paketunay a musuayay tu ahahulakan a kawaw. uzuma a kawaw amalilid ku wayway nu miliwkuay a labang. zuma a tademaw hini sa lulunuk paculil a kazizeng amacunus ku kayaday nu kazizeng atu kinapina a micukaymas, zayhan amadayum a paculilen, saaca sangaleb amicukaymas. hakay mahiniay tu wamin ku i tuseay, amacunus ku kayadah nu teked nu micukaymasay tu kazizang. Hinisa ku zuma a tademaw, sangaleb madayum mapulung amisazakez, sakasa acaaay kahami asitungus tu kaizaw nu kazizeng, amakelul ku picukaymas, ngay u kazizeng taneng kikadadawaen tu nu ayzaay a patayza. likec法律 i Ameylika, kasa kuwan a niyazu' bangu a paya nu kazizeng caay palaayaw "nika haka caay pasatezepen" i kacakat lunuk sanay a saculilan. amihapinang mikuwan tu mahiniay a saculilan, zuma a cow a cenbu misanga' tu anca mizateng a misanga' tu pakayniay nu likec. masatezep i 2013 a mihcaan, Ameylika sepat tu a cow "Ney-ba-ta-cow, Bu-cow, Cya-cow atu Mi-vu-kan-cow", atu Ke-lun-pi-ya-te kitizaan, malaheci ku nisanga' milisimet tu lunukay nu mitupinay a likec.

Yadah ku ay a tabakiay a kusi atu migingkuway a sakaput malingatu tu misanga' tu mahizaay tu nu lunuk paculil a kazizeng, pasu Me-say-te-sa pins, tung-yung kazizeng, Talu kazizeng, lAV, meyan, Law-puw.poe-s kusi, Zipun a nisanga'an a kazizeng,ley-now, Toyuta kazizeng, Aw-ti, bu-haw sakaput, paw-s kazizeng, pa-al-ma talakaway a cacudadanay a Vislab, niw-cin talakaway a cacudadan, atu Google. zikuz nu 21 seci, m ikilul tu sapasingding a macakat, bahal satu macakat, hamin u lunuk paculil a kazizeng mitanamay tu kazizengay u masan ga'ay tu, te-s-la a kazizeng u saayaway a nipanutekan a patahkal tu lunuk paculil a kazizeng. 2013 a mihca 7 a bulad, 2013 a mihca 7 a bulad, Vislab paazih tu BRAiVE hananay nu lunuk paculil a kazizeng, mitanam mikinsa tu ngatu zazan pasu "zuma malecaday tu a kazizeng" muculil i zazan. katukuh 2013 a mihcaan, Ameylika sepat a kuwanan "Ney-huwa-ta-cow, How-cow, Cya-cow atu Mi-siken-cow" maawas tu nu hulic misulul tu lunuk paculil a kazizeng. 2015 a mihcaan. uyni sepatay a kuwan atu How-sen-tun-Ke-lun-piya-te a kitizaan misulul tu tu lunuk paculil a kazizeng paculil i zazan a mikinsa, mikilul tu ku Wiy-ci-ni-ya-cow. 018 a mihca 3 a bulad 18 a demiad a tu labii,I Ya-li-san-na-cow-tan-pey-s, cacay lunuk paculil a kazizengay a Uber a kazizeng habelutan ku cacay nu micaliwayay i zazan a tademaw mapatay. uyni u saayaway nu kitakit a lunuk paculil a kazizang nu simapatayay nu tademaw. tizaay a tayzin mihapiw tu mihcaan nu mapatayay 49 ku mihcaan ci He-cepoke "Elaine Herzberg", kazizeng izaw ku palihalayay apaculilay, itaway muenengay i paculilan, caay kaitiza maduka. Namahini ku kawaw, mahabelutay a tademaw makay ayaw nu kazizang kawilian micuzuh tu batikal, caay henay pihaymaw paculnil atu piliyas ku nipaculil, hakay u patelac nu lunuk paculil a kazizeng. patahkal ku tayzin tu niadinguan paazih, situngusa a tademaw caay piazih, itawya i labu nu kaziza pacemek niza miazih tu limaki, caay pihapinang amiazih. misetulay a kazizeng sa bu-haw XC90 SUV. Ameylika kanatak saculil a zazan nu mikuwanay "National Highway Traffic Safety Administration" i pasay zazan tu pakay saykay a nipatahkalan a kamu hinisa, uyni a sakaput "tu pakayniay a akawaw" atu yu-pu, bu-haw, lyen-pang-tang-ci,cow atu tizaay a kuwan makakaput tu" amisatudung a mikawaw. XC90 SUV. . saculilan tungus tekeday pulung nu kayadah Zipun Toyota u silac nu ngangan u icibangay, Ameylika bu-te atu tung-yumg a kazizang pazuma tu ngangan u sakatusa atu sakatulu. Pi-li-s, Ba-kow, I-tali atu Ing-kow misabalucu' amin au lunuk paculil a kazizeng ku mikawaway tu miculu' patayza, i Te-kow, He-lan atu S-pan-ya a kanatalan, misulul tu amin tu mitanam tu kakapah nu lunuk paculil a kazizeng. 2015 a mihcaan, Ing-kow a cebu misulul tu lunuk paculil a kazizeng LUTZ Pathfinder i Mi-al-tu -kay-en-s a zazan mikinsa. yu malaheci tu keci tu lunuk paculil a kazizenge, alesan tu ku silamalay a zazan caay katahpu ku saculilan. hamin u lunuk paculil a kazizang anu tanenng pasazumaen tu nu siwbayay, amahamin mapeci pabaluhay a tabaki ku nkalilid nu syakay. lunuk paculil a kazizeng hakay katuud ku micukaymasay imahini nayi' henay ku wanta, anu tatenga' katuud ku micukaymasay, paketunay a musuayay tu ahahulakan a kawaw. uzuma a kawaw amalilid ku wayway nu miliwkuay a labang. zuma a tademaw hini sa lulunuk paculil a kazizeng amacunus ku kayaday nu kazizeng atu kinapina a micukaymas, zayhan amadayum a paculilen, saaca sangaleb amicukaymas. hakay mahiniay tu wamin ku i tuseay, amacunus ku kayadah nu teked nu micukaymasay tu kazizang. Hinisa ku zuma a tademaw, sangaleb madayum mapulung amisazakez, sakasa acaaay kahami asitungus tu kaizaw nu kazizeng, amakelul ku picukaymas, ngay u kazizeng taneng kikadadawaen tu nu ayzaay a patayza. likec法律 i Ameylika, kasa kuwan a niyazu' bangu a paya nu kazizeng caay palaayaw "nika haka caay pasatezepen" i kacakat lunuk sanay a saculilan. amihapinang mikuwan tu mahiniay a saculilan, zuma a cow a cenbu misanga' tu anca mizateng a misanga' tu pakayniay nu likec. masatezep i 2013 a mihcaan, Ameylika sepat tu a cow "Ney-ba-ta-cow, Bu-cow, Cya-cow atu Mi-vu-kan-cow", atu Ke-lun-pi-ya-te kitizaan, malaheci ku nisanga' milisimet tu lunukay nu mitupinay a likec.
